name: Kondou Nagisa
source:
A third-year student in the piano department at Shukusei Music Academy. She is so naive that she can't even ride the train alone.
She's a sheltered girl, more cute than beautiful.
She's kind to everyone, and is rather "gentle." She
doesn't know what it means to deceive others and doesn't think about being deceived by others.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/19980701104740/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/special/syusaku/syusaku7.htm]the game's website, archived[/url]]
